label: prf:descartes-braid-structure
title: Proof of Braid-group structure of a Descartes universe
html:
Item (1) follows from braid action on tensor products applied to the fundamental representation V of \mathrm{SU}_q(2), which is 2-dimensional. The braiding c_{V,V} is computed by the R-matrix of \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) (R-matrix braiding), and faithfulness follows from the fact that the eigenvalues of c_{V,V} are q and -q^{-1}, which are distinct for q \neq \pm 1.

For item (2), the fibre functor \tau sends the braiding to the matrix \check{R} = P \circ \mathcal{R} acting on \mathbb{C}^2 \otimes \mathbb{C}^2. The generators \sigma_1, \sigma_2 map to the \mathrm{SU}(2) elements \alpha, \beta (SU(2) generators) generating \mathrm{Dic}_3, as verified in trefoil operator algebra.

Item (3): the projection \mathrm{Dic}_3 \to S_3 sends \alpha \mapsto (123) and \beta \mapsto (12). The three copies of S_3 inside S_5 are the stabilisers of the three pairs of color coordinates (color sector coords), and conjugation by elements of S_5 \setminus S_3 permutes these copies.

Item (4): the braided monoidal structure of \mathrm{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}_q(2)) is defined over R[q, q^{-1}] with 30 \in R^{\times} (Bring's surface is QOU(1)), and braid action on tensor products requires no topological input beyond the hexagon axioms.
